blocks.text: The hidden cost of manual ad optimization

Manual ad optimization is a silent budget killer. When you manage every bid and placement by hand, you miss the speed of algorithmic adjustments. This leads to wasted spend that could have been avoided with automated guardrails.

The core issue is context switching. Research shows your brain needs 23 minutes to refocus after moving between apps like Meta Ads Manager and Slack. If you check your ads every hour, you never reach a state of deep work.

items: Set up automated rules in your ad platforms to pause ads when CPA hits a specific limit.
Use a dedicated workspace manager like SupaSidebar on your Mac to keep ad accounts in separate windows.
Limit your manual check-ins to twice per day to avoid the context-switching trap.
Audit your active channels and close those that are not driving direct business results.

blocks.text: How Lazur helps you manage ads

Lazur helps you stay focused by answering questions about your screen without you needing to switch tabs. You can ask about a specific metric on your dashboard, and Lazur will point it out while you keep your current view.
A structured routine prevents the weekend work trap. By frontloading your creative work in the morning, you allow your automated rules to handle the heavy lifting during the afternoon.

items: Over-optimizing before the algorithm has enough data to learn.

faq.question: How do I stop manual ad monitoring from burning me out?
faq.answer: Shift to rule-based automation. Set thresholds for your campaigns so the platform pauses underperforming ads for you. This removes the need for constant, hourly manual checks.

faq.question: Does Lazur manage my ad campaigns for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur is a voice assistant that helps you find information on your screen, guides you through tasks, and answers questions. It does not click buttons or edit your ad settings.

faq.question: What is the best way to handle multiple brand accounts on a Mac?
faq.answer: Use a workspace manager like SupaSidebar to isolate your browser sessions and tabs. This prevents accidental cross-posting and keeps your ad dashboards organized.
